thread:
maria: Dropping a thread to capture action items from yesterday's authz outage. Root cause looks like token-validator GC pause + missing fallback to cached JWKS. Need explicit owners/timelines for: immediate fix, audit logging, secrets rotation, and recurrence checks.

devsec-bot: INCIDENT #2026-318: authz: token validation errors spike 03/22 11:12-11:48. Affected: hosted API + Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: I'll own the immediate fix (circuit-breaker + cache fallback in token-validator). ETA: EOD Fri 03/26.

alex: I'll own telemetry and alert tuning (add histogram for JWKS fetch latency, reduce noisy alerts). PR to staging today.

tanya: I'll draft customer comms for affected accounts — waiting on jamie's ETA to schedule send.

maria: Action list here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions. Owners + due dates added — please add sub-tasks and update status by EOD tomorrow. Quick highlights:
- Immediate code fix (cache fallback + circuit breaker) -> owner: jamie -> due 03/26 EOD
- Telemetry + alerts -> owner: alex -> due 03/28
- Audit log schema + retention check -> owner: alex + devsec -> due 03/28
- Service principal rotation for token-validator -> owner: devsec -> scheduled 03/28
- Customer comms -> owner: tanya -> send after jamie's confirmation

jamie: A few technical notes: recurring pattern we've seen — services with large heap + GC tuning result in pause spikes; token-validator spawns JWKS fetch threads which block on network. Short-term: reduce heap and tune GC (G1 pause target). Medium-term: move JWKS fetch into small, single-purpose sidecar with its own process limits.

alex: For audit logging, propose adding per-tenant events to index "authz.audit" with fields: subject_id, token_id (hash), jwks_fetch_ts, verdict, error_code. Example query to find failure modes:
```
index=authz.audit (error_code=TOKEN_EXPIRY OR error_code=JWKS_FETCH_FAIL) | stats count by error_code, tenant
```
This will help quickly spot tenant-specific noise vs platform issues.

devsec-bot: Remediation ticket created: RDW-SEC-12458 — rotate service principal used by token-validator; scheduled window 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maria: @jamie @alex please confirm owners in the sheet. Also proposing a recurring check-in for "token health" until metrics stabilise: start Mon 03/30, weekly stand for 6 weeks (15 mins). I'll add calendar invites.

jamie: Confirmed. I'll also write a short runbook snippet for failover and paste it into the sheet. Runbook example:
```
if jwks_fetch_latency > 500ms:\n  use cached_jwks\n  incremental_backoff_for_jwks_fetch\n  alert if cached_jwks_age > 60s\n```
I'll drop the full snippet in the sheet by EOD Fri.

tanya: :thumbsup: I'll hold comms until jamie's EOD update. Please add me to the owner column in the sheet.

maria: Thanks all. Recap of immediate next steps (please ack with :eyes: in-thread):
1) jamie: patch + runbook (03/26 EOD)
2) alex: telemetry + alerts + audit schema (03/28)
3) devsec: service principal rotation + verify secrets (03/28)
4) tanya: customer comms after jamie's confirmation
Scheduling: first check-in Mon 03/30, then weekly. If anything slips, update the sheet and ping @maria.
